spans.text: ...Somewhere in the refugee settlement.
Special explosives are being passed among people dressed in rags.
All supplies have been distributed. Mr. Powell has given the order!
Great! Kill anyone who isnt one of us! We've lived under their oppression for far too long! Today, we'll give those Krauts what they deserve!
Yes!!
I've been waiting for this!!
Come with me!
Spare no one!!
...Elsewhere in the refugee settlement.
Our advance unit got wiped out.
We've already failed once, we must not fail a second time.
Understood!
We all know what's at stake. If we fail to capture our target, all the sacrifices we have made will be for nothing.
So hold nothing back. Failure is not an option.
Yes, sir!
Let's go!
...Ange's group is en route to capturing Powell.
Her finger slides over the crisscrossing alleyways on the map.
There are no more buildings ahead. We have to get back down onto ground level.
Do you have a route planned?
I like playing things by ear.
...You don't have to trust me.
But you don't have be so suspicious either. I'm just trying to help.
I'm not. The refugees' movements are erratic, so we can only adjust our route on the fly.
Check your ammo, we're definitely going to get into some firefights.
I still have four mags and an extra box of cartridges.
But ammo reserve aside, there's no way we can fight so many insurgents with just our pistols. How many times do I have to explain this to you?
I also have four mags. Didn't know you're so bossy, Hopps. Thinking about jumping ship?
...I just want to drag us back to shore before we have the chance to drown.
No intel, no plan, no reinforcements. No matter how you cut it, this is suicide.
Stop complaining and keep up.
Be quiet. Get ready to go inside the house.
W-What's going on...?
A group of armed refugees are charging this way ferociously from across the street.
They're looking about as if searching for something.
They're gone...
Impossible. They've got to be nearby. They must be hiding in the ruins.
Find them!
How do they know where we are?
Its not hard, we stick out like sore thumbs.
Let's take a detour through the alley before moving to this area.
How do you know we won't run into any refugees this way?
I don't, but I do know that if we don't go now, the refugees in that building over there will happily skin us alive.
Where are they?!
Just go!
They're running! Don't let them get away!
Catch them!!!
Go!!!
As the refugees come charging at them, the group of four spare no time and take off immediately.
We should go south! The terrain is more varied there; I'm confident we can shake them off!
No, we keep going west!
Are you...
Are you joking? The refugees are coming from the west.
Ange ignores him and runs straight into an alley leading to the west.
Hopps has no choice but to follow.
Hopps...
Ange probably thinks that since the refugees are coming from this direction, we can be certain Powell is indeed at the Refugee Support Center HQ.
She's only concerned about capturing Powell. She doesn't give a damn about us!
Quit whining, focus on running instead.
Bangbangbang!
A series of gunshots go off behind them.
Aaaaah!
Don't be afraid! I'll cover you from behind!
Don't stop! Keep heading west! The enemies are exchanging fire with each other!
They're here!
Bro, we've got coppers! The damn coppers are behind us! Argh!
Oh, for God's sake!
We'll stay and hold them back! You go after those bastards!
Shots keep being fired to the south of the crossroads. Just as Ange's group think they have shaken off their pursuers...
More refugees come charging at them from the alley ahead.
There they are!
Kill them!
Are we covered in homing beacons or something?!
Dammit, there are too many refugees in the settlement.
If we had gone south as I suggested, we'd be safe by now.
How do you know we won't be ambushed in the south?
Ange... Maybe we can head south first to shake off the refugees?
No, we are not turning back!
Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
Our enemies are busy shooting each other behind us. We can draw the people coming from the west over there. They want chaos? We'll stoke the fire.
And how are you planning to get out of the fire yourself?
I'll leave that to your expertise.
The more out of hand the situation gets, the more opportunities we have.
...This is crazy.
Hopps, show Ange some faith.
Do I even have a choice? I wish I could be as optimistic as you.
...It can't be helped. I don't want to imagine what the refugees would do if they got their hands on us.
Right now we need to work together as a team. Let's catch up with Ange!
Bangbangbang!
Using their limited supply of ammo, the group of four sprint towards the chaotic firefight.
Chief, requesting precise coordinates. Requesting precise coordinates. The crossfire is getting out of hand. We require precise coordinates.
Dammit, I can't get in touch with the chief. These refugees are bad news. We're taking too many casualties. At this rate, we're going to lose our target.
Forget about the refugees and avoid contact. Our field unit just reported back. We've found Sparrow. Now it's only a matter of time until the Pigeon comes for it.
Splendid! Make it so.
...On the other side of the refugee settlement, a few people are observing the crossfire from an abandoned building.
Mr. Powell, the rats have fled.
Those German imbeciles. They're the first to run when it truly matters.
Mr. Powell? Mr. Powell! ...Where are you?
I've got news!
What is it?
Sorry, we've lost her.
The bitch took off like the wind in the melee.
Doesn't matter. This is our turf, she can't hide for long.
...Hold on, how did you get in here? What about my guards outside?
Guards? What guards?
I didn't see anyone when I came in.
Oh no, Mr. Powell. You've got to...
Yes, I know.
You! Take a few men and set up defenses here. Have some of your friends inspect this block.
Open fire if they see anyone suspicious!
Yes, Mr. Powell!
...Let's go. It's a bad idea to stay here any longer.
These rats sure have sharp teeth.
Powell promptly leaves through the window under the protection of his entourage.
15 minutes later, in the same room.
Three armed agents decked in high-quality gear interrogate the last survivor in the building with a picana connected to a car battery.
Where did the fatso go? Say it!
(Spits) Damn cop... AAAARGHHH!!!
Vice-cap, the block has been cleared out. Just a bunch of goons, no sign of Sparrow.
Got it. Notify the local teams to scout Zone C3.
Have Team A head north and get Team B to catch up with Pigeon. He shouldn't have gone too far.
He is bound to mess up if we keep up the pressure. They're not pros.
Roger! And what do we do with this guy?
The leader unholsters his pistol and shoots the refugee still being electrocuted in the thigh.
GAAHHHH!!!
I'll pry the information out of him. Any more questions?
No, sir!
Then carry on with your orders.
Yes, sir!
